docs.text: 1 課程大綱 科 號 學 分 3 學分 人數限制 25 人 任 課 教 師 林保全 時 間 教 室 科目中文名稱 中國文獻載體概論及實作 科目英文名稱 Introduction to Documentary Carriers In Chinese Literature and Practice 一、課程說明 參見次頁所附。 二、指定用書 參見次頁所附。 三、參考書籍 參見次頁所附。 四、教學方式 參見次頁所附。 五、教學進度 參見次頁所附。 六、成績考核 參見次頁所附。 七、講義位址 h t t p : / / 參見次頁所附。 2 一、課程說明 1. 建立漢字書寫載體的知識與文化系統。 2. 融入文獻載體的實作與體驗，觀察其形成與製作的過程，從而以「行」的方式驗 證「知」的領域。 3. 藉由上述知識的積累，鼓勵同學進行二次文創，達成雙向學習的效果。 二、指定用書 1. 教師自編教材。 三、參考書籍 1. 趙海麗等：《中國文獻載體演變史》，濟南：齊魯，2017。 2. 于省吾《雙劍誃吉金文選》，北京：中華，2009 年。 3. 王國維《生霸死霸考》，台北：藝文出版社，1971 年。 4. 王國維《觀堂集林》，台北：河洛圖書，1975 年。 5. 王國維《古史新證》，收入《王國維全集》第 11 冊，杭州：浙江教育；廣州：廣 東教育，2009 年。 6. 王國維《觀堂古金文考釋》，收入《王國維全集》第 11 冊，杭州：浙江教育；廣 州：廣東教育，2009 年。 7. 宋鎮豪等主編《甲骨文獻集成》，成都：四川大學出版社，2001 年。 8. 李零〈郭店楚簡校讀記〉，《道家文化研究》，第十七輯，「郭店楚簡」專號，香港： 三聯書店，1999 年 8 月 。 9. 李零《郭店楚簡校讀記(增訂本)》，北京：北京大學出版社，2002 年 3 月 。 10. 李學勤〈先秦儒家著作的重大發現〉，《中國哲學》，第 20 輯，1999 年 1 月 。 11. 李學勤〈帛書五行與尚書洪範〉，《學術月刊》，第 11 期，1986 年 11 月 。 12. 李學勤〈荊門郭店楚簡中的子思子〉，《中國哲學》，第 20 輯，1999 年 1 月 。 13. 李學勤〈從簡帛佚籍《五行》談到《大學》〉，《中國哲學》，1999 年 2 月。 14. 周鳳五〈讀郭店竹簡《成之聞之》劄記〉，《古文字與古文獻》，試刊號，1999 年 10 月 。 15. 周鳳五〈郭店竹簡的形式特徵與分類意義〉，《郭店楚簡國際學術研討會論文集》， 美國哈佛大學、武漢大學主辦，湖北人民出版社，2000 年 5 月。 16. 周鳳五〈傳統漢學經典的再生──以《清華簡・保訓》「中」字為例〉，臺北：《漢 學研究通訊》，2012 年 5 月號。 17. 周鳳五主編：《先秦文本及思想之形成、發展與轉化（上）（下）》 ，台北：國立 臺灣大學出版社，2013 年。 18. 胡厚宣《殷墟發掘》，上海：學習出版社，1955 年。 19. 荊門市博物館編《郭店楚墓竹簡》，北京：文物，1998 年 5 月。 20. 涂宗流《郭店楚簡先秦儒家佚書校釋》，臺北：萬卷樓圖書有限公司，2001 年 2 月。 21. 馬王堆漢墓帛書整理小組：《馬王堆漢墓帛書》，北京 : 文物出版社, 1978 年。 22. 清華大學出土文獻硏究與保護中心編 ; 李學勤主編《清華大學藏戰國竹簡》，上 海 : 中西書局, 2010。 23. 郭沫若《卜辭通纂》，北京：科學出版社，1983 年。 24. 陳夢家《殷墟卜辭綜述》，台北：大通，1971 年。 25. 陳夢家《西周銅器斷代》，北京：中華，2004 年。 26. 湖北省荊門市博物館：〈荊門郭店一號楚墓〉，《文物》，第 7 期，1997 年 。 27. 湖北省荊沙路考古隊：〈包山楚簡〉，《文物》，1991 年。 28. 勞榦：《居延漢簡》，台北市 : 中央硏究院歷史語言硏究所,1957-1960 年。裘錫圭 《古代文史研究新探》，南京，江蘇古籍，1992 年。 3 29. 董作賓《殷曆譜》，四川南溪：中央研究院歷史語言研究所，1945 年。 30. 劉信芳《簡帛五行解詁》，臺北：藝文印書館，2000 年 12 月 。 31. 劉信芳《包山楚簡解詁》，臺北：藝文印書館，2003 年 12 月 。 32. 韓仲民〈長沙馬王堆漢墓帛書概述〉，《文物》，1974 年第 9 期， 33. 顧史考（ Scott Cook）：《郭店楚簡先秦儒書宏微觀》，上海：上海古籍出版社， 2012 年。 34. 羅振玉《殷商貞卜文字考》，收入宋鎮豪等主編《甲骨文獻集成》第 7 冊，成都： 四川大學出版社，2001 年。 35. 影視資料： ①. 《甲骨文朝》（CCTV 製作） ②. 《二十世紀重大考古紀錄：馬王堆大發現（上）、（下）》（CCTV 紀錄製作） ③. 《荊門戰國楚墓（上）、（下）》（中華國寶製作） ④. 《揭秘睡虎地（一）、（二）、（三）》（中華國寶製作） ⑤. 《雲夢秦墓（上）、（下）》（中華國寶製作） ⑥. 李零《簡帛古書與學術源流（修訂本）》（北京：三聯，2020 年）。 四、教學方式 1. 自主學習：課前應針對所指定之講義進行閱讀或完成該週指定課業。 2. 主題式教學：各週或數週以主題式進行教學，藉以掌握儒家核心思想。 3. 引導式問題討論：特定週數的第三節進行分組討論，藉以培養學生思考與表達能 力。 4. 教師講述理論 60％，教師與學生互動式討論與報告 40％。 5. 特定週數為討論課或實作課程，藉由相關主題的設計，進行教師與學生之間的互 動式討論與實際操作。知識講授佔整體課程 50％，跨文化實作與體驗佔整體課程 50％ 五、教學進度（本課程為 16 週課程，☐內週數為實作週） 主題（一）：陶泥、龜卜、腹甲與甲骨卜辭（第 1、2、3、4 週） 1. 陶泥與符號 2. 殷墟甲骨的發現。 3. 甲骨的製作與形制特色。 4. 甲骨文的功能與文字特色。 5. 甲骨文刻寫實作、周易古法實作。 主題（二）青銅器與吉金文字（第 5、6、7 週） 1. 青銅器的製作、形制與功能。 2. 鍾鼎文的功能與文字特色。 3. 重要青銅器、鍾鼎文導論。 4. 青銅器的塑形與脫模實作。 主題（三）簡牘、帛書與戰國文字、秦漢古今隸（第 8、9 週） 1. 簡牘、帛書的製作、形制與功能。 2. 簡牘、帛書文字的功能與文字特色。 3. 重要簡牘、帛書及戰國文字、大小篆、古今隸導論。 4. 竹簡書寫與編聯實作。 4 主題（四）石刻（第 10、11 週） 1. 石刻的形制、類型與功能。 2. 歷代重要石刻文獻導論。 3. 石刻常見的文字類型與特色。 4. 拓碑實作。 主題（五）紙張與卷軸、抄本、敦煌寫本（第 12、13、14 週） 1. 紙的製作、形制與流傳過程。 2. 卷軸的文獻特質。 3. 卷軸形制與裝幀及其文字類型。 4. 手工抄紙實作、卷軸製作實作。 主題（六）雕版印刷、木活字、鉛活字與刊本（第 15、16 週） 1. 雕版、活字印刷的製作、形制與流傳過程。 2. 雕版、活字印刷的文獻特質。 3. 刊本形制與各種常見的裝幀類型及其文字型態。 4. 雕版印刷實作、鉛活字印刷、各式刊物裝幀實作。 主題（七）校外參訪及實作：九芎林紙寮窩（若無經費，則無此項） 1. 廠區概況。 2. 手工造紙全流程。 3. 實作：搗樹皮、絹印實作與體驗 主題（八）校外參訪及實作：日星鑄字行（若無經費，則無此項） 1. 廠區概況。 2. 鉛活字印刷流程。 3. 鉛活字印實作與體驗。 六、成績考核 1. 心得作業 30％。（共 3 篇，每篇 300～500 字左右，每篇 10％。） 2. 出席率 10%。（每週點名，每次 1％。） 3. 課堂參討論及實作 30%。（任選 5 次實作成果繳交，每項 6％） 4. 期末作業 30%。（一篇 3 千至 5 千字的期末報告。） 七、講義位址 國立清華大學 eeclass 數位學習平台 www.eeclass.nthu.edu.tw 注意事項 1. 請勿直接轉貼 AI 資料於任何形式的作業。 2. 4 月 2 日（第六週），校際活動週，停課一次。

docs.name: 國別化華語文化教材編寫與設計
docs.nameEn: Designing and Developing Culturally Localized Chinese Language Teaching Materials
docs.text: 國立清華大學課程大綱 科號 Course Number 11420IBP 309000 學分 Credit 2 人數限制 Class Size 中文名稱 Course Title 國別化華語文化教材編寫與設計 英文名稱 Course English Title Designing and Developing Culturally Localized Chinese Language Teaching Materials 任課教師 Instructor 羅仕龍（LO, Shih-Lung） 上課時間 Time M1M2 上課教室 Room 教育館 101 學生修課條件 (選課系統之備註 欄) 主要提供給大三以上學生。 程度：修畢任一「高級華語」課程。 （第三階段開放其他科系選課） 一、課程簡述(必填) (最多 500 個中文字) 本欄位資料會上傳教育部課程網 Brief Course Description (required) (50-200 words if possible, up to 1000 letters) 本課程以「國別化」（localization）為核心概念，探討華語文化教材在跨國教學情境中的設計原則與 實踐方法。隨著華語學習者遍布全球，不同國家的文化脈絡、教育制度與學習需求各異，單一版本的華 語教材已難以全面回應不同國家、文化背景的在地需求。因此，本課程旨在引導學生思考，當華語作為 第二語言進入課堂時，「文化」如何被呈現、詮釋與再造？教材中的文化內容是否真能促進跨文化理 解，抑或只是複製刻板印象？ 課程將從理論與實務雙軌進行。理論面涵蓋文化教材的發展歷程、在地化與全球化的討論、文化翻譯、 轉譯與跨文化溝通等概念；實務面則期待引導學生以特定國家或地區為對象，進行學習者需求分析、文 化主題規畫、篇章與活動設計，並試著製作可用的的教材。學生將透過案例研究與討論（如果可能的 話，可以安排試教），掌握教材評估與修訂的流程，並學習如何在文化意象、教學任務與語言習得之間 取得平衡。本課程期望修課者在課程結束後，不僅具備華語教材編寫的理論基礎與實務能力，更能嘗試 以批判性與創造性的眼光，針對不同國家/地區文化背景的學習者，設計出兼具文化深度與教學功效並 且帶有台灣文化特點的華語文化教材。 二、課程內容「中文暨英文關鍵字」(必填) 至少 5 個,每個關鍵字至多 20 個中文,以半形逗點分隔 Please fill in at least 5 course keywords (up to 40 letters for each keyword) and use commas to separate them.(required) 國別化（Localization）, 文化教材（Cultural Materials）, 跨文化溝通（Intercultural Communication）, 文化翻譯（Cultural Translation）, 教材設計（Material Design） 三、課程大綱(必填)Detailed Course Syllabus 1, 課程說明(Course Description) 本課程聚焦於華語文化教材的「國別化」設計，探討華語在不同國家教學情境中如何結合在地文化、教育制度與學習需求，發 展出具地方適切性的教材內容。課程兼顧理論與實務，從文化教材的發展脈絡、跨文化溝通與文化翻譯等概念出發，引導學生 理解文化再現與教材敘事的關聯。學生將學習如何分析學習者需求、規劃文化主題與設計教學篇章，並嘗試以特定國家為例， 完成初步的華語教材。透過案例分析、同儕回饋與演練，學生將具備國別化華語教材的設計思維與文化敏銳度，能以批判且具 有創造力的視角，為不同文化背景的學習者設計多元、深度且帶有台灣文化特點的華語文化教材。 2. 指定用書(Text Books) 教師自編教材 3.參考書籍(References) 不同地區出版的華語文化教材（因應教師本身專業背景，法國出版的華語教材有可能會在比較多教學場次使用） 4.教學方式(Teaching Method) 理論講述；實作演練；小組討論 5.教學進度(Syllabus) 學期週 日期 課程進度 第一週 2/23 課程導論：什麼是「國別化華語教材」？ 第二週 3/2 華語文化教材的歷史與發展 第三週 3/9 「國別化」及文化翻譯的概念與理論基礎 第四週 3/16 不同國家學習者的文化背景、需求分析方法 第五週 3/23 文化教材內容的選擇與篩選原則 第六週 3/30 教材中的文化表徵與意識形態、跨文化溝通與文化誤解 第七週 4/6 春假 第八週 4/13 文化主題分類與單元設計法 第九週 4/20 國別化教材案例研究（I） 第十週 4/27 國別化教材案例研究（II） 第十一週 5/4 教材文本創作與文化敘事 第十二週 5/11 多媒體與文化教材 第十三週 5/18 教材試教與文化反思 第十四週 5/25 教材評估與修訂 第十五週 6/1 總結：華語文化教材的永續與創新 第十六週 6/8 成果發表 6.成績考核(Evaluation) 課堂參與與討論 20%；學習者需求分析報告 15% ；教材文化分析作業15% 小組國別化教材設計專案 30%；期末成果發表 20% 四、採用下列何項 AI 使用規則 (Indicate which of the following options you use to manage student use of the AI) 有條件開放，並請註明如何使用生成式 AI 於課程產出 Conditionally open; please specify how generative AI will be used in course output 五、可連結之網頁位址或相關網頁(Personal Website)

docs.name: 華人神話與傳說
docs.text: 1 國立清華大學國際學士班甲組課程大綱 中文名稱 Course Title 華人神話與傳說 Chinese myths and legends 任課教師 Instructor 林佳儀 上課時間 Time T2T3T4 上課教室 Room 教育館 101 一、課程說明(Course Description) 神話與傳說，承載著一個民族對自然現象的想像與解釋，還有代代相傳、百聽不厭的故 事。這門課程，將選讀華人神話與傳說（閱讀白話改寫本），並搭配圖像，討論故事內涵、 神話傳說與現代生活的關連；而同學們則報告母國相關神話傳說，認識相似現象的不同解讀 與演繹，共同進入異想世界。（建議修畢「中高級華語」（三），再修習本課程） 關鍵字：神話 傳說, myth, legend 二、教學方式(Teaching Method) 教師講述、師生討論、個人作業、口頭報告 三、教學進度(Syllabus) （將依實際上課情形調整）(第一週即正式上課，請準時出席) 週次 日期 課 程 進 度 分散式口頭報告 一 2/24 課程說明｜開天闢地、女媧造人【附：正月初九天公生】 二 3/3 爬上天梯的伏羲、葫蘆兄妹【附：正月十五天官賜福】 三 3/10 【本日不上課，改為 4/12（日）校外教學】 四 3/17 新竹竹蓮寺＆市場週邊小旅行 五 3/24 射太陽的勇士、大巨人夸父追日 六 3/31 后羿大戰怪獸、嫦娥奔月 七 4/7 鯀偷了天上的泥土、大禹治水 4/12 日 【赴苗栗西湖校外教學，早上出發，下午回程】 八 4/14 分組演劇｜虎姑婆 九 4/21 不死心的精衛鳥、天上來的雷官 十 4/28 河神娶妻、李冰鬥江神 十一 5/5 桃花女鬥周乾、趣談「大道公風，媽祖婆雨」 十二 5/12 桃花源、石獅的眼睛流血了 十三 5/19 蒙古少年的馬頭琴、牛郎織女、月下老人牽紅線 十四 5/26 關羽過五關斬六將、曹操逃到華容道 十五 6/2 日月潭的傳奇、愛說謊的白賊七 十六 6/9 紙筆測驗 2 說明： 1、 每個故事有生動的朗讀，請搭配文本閱讀預習。 https://reurl.cc/NNQaae 2、 每次小考（10 題選擇題，登入 eeclass，限時測驗，立即評分）。 3、 每位同學報告母國神話傳說之前，請先與老師討論（線上或實體），並讓老師閱讀文字 初稿。 4、 將視課程進度、同學學習情形彈性調整，或安排活動。 四、成績考核(Evaluation) 課堂參與（20%）：出席、課堂討論。 課堂小考（20%）：預習考試或課間測驗（登入 eeclass，限時測驗，立即評分）。 踏查筆記（10%）：苗栗西湖踏查的影像及文字記錄（照片至少 5 張，搭配圖片說明；報導或 心得，至少 300 字），請 4 月 30 日前至 eeclass 繳交作業。 個人報告（10%）：每人報告以 6 分鐘為原則。分享一則母國神話或傳說（包含故事內容、解 說及相關圖像等），口頭報告、書面文件（請遵守版面規定、需說明參考資料、不能抄 襲或使用 AI）。 分組演劇（20%）：故事創作及演出，演出前先提供介紹（包含：故事名稱、故事內容、靈感 來源、創作動機、工作分配），演出需搭配音樂、道具、識別物。 紙筆測驗（20%）：Open Book 筆試（閱讀測驗、心得寫作、神話比較等）。 五、參考書籍(References) 漢聲雜誌社：《中國童話》（共 12 冊），台北：英文漢聲出版社，1982 年初版。 漢聲雜誌社：《中國童話 CD》（共 72 片），台北：英文漢聲出版社，2009 年。 六、AI 使用規則 1. 可以使用 AI 協助思考，但禁止使用 AI 生成心得、報告部分內容，若經查核發現，教師、 學校或相關單位有權重新針對作業或報告重新評分或不予計分。 2. 請勿使用 AI 潤飾作業，老師希望看到大家真實的情感及表述，而不是美麗卻沒有個性的 作品。當潤飾過度，老師無法判斷是真人寫作還是 AI 生成，難以公正給分。 3. 修讀本課程之學生於選課時視為同意以上倫理聲明。

docs.name: 中國詩詞欣賞
docs.text: 1 以中國詩詞作為媒介的生命書寫與跨文化情感理解為 主的課程— 中國詩詞欣賞 課程大綱 時間：星期一 2、3、4 節 教室：清大校本部教育館 301 授課老師：黃雅莉 研究室：文學館 202 聯絡電話：0911073247 、5715131 轉 61319 mail： yali@mx.nthu.edu.tw , huangyali1966@gmail.com 一、課程簡介 本課程旨在透過授課老師的帶領，教導外籍學生初步認識具有藝術美感、人文精 神和思想底蘊的中國古代具有代表性詩詞名家與名篇。 古典詩詞是中國文化長河中最璀璨動人的明珠，其中所蘊含的藝術美感和人文情 懷一直影響著後人，成為中國人文精神的核心，透過此而對於外籍生理解中國文化， 有著不可替代的作用。本課程授課對象是外籍生，課程的內容是對詩詞作品之語言文 字、意象形象、思想內涵的由表及裡的層層認識，是屬於中國文學作品中比較深層與 高級的閱讀，建議選課的同學必須能掌握 3000 個以上中文詞彙量或在臺灣中文學習總 時數達到 500 時數，建議修畢高級華語二，再修習本課程比較容易掌握。 本課程的安排大抵從《詩經》、漢樂府、古詩十九首、唐詩、唐五代詞、宋詞，選 出具代表性的詩家與經典名篇，除了幫助外籍生理解中國古代的詩歌體式的發展，也 期望能以此為範本，透過對作品的解說，引導外籍學生從詩歌的意象、語言、情感、 意境等方面去發現詩藝美、感受詩情美、品賞詩思美，強化詩歌的審美教育功能。除 了定期小考之外，同學們在期末可以選擇一首對自己影響最深的詩詞，也可以是自己 母國的詩作，結合自己的人生經歷，進行自己的閱讀感想的交流，體認這首詩作與中 國詩詞相似相通的情境，分享自己的解讀和感受，創造課程中共情同感的交流。 二、課程目標 1、指導學生學習如何去欣賞中國古典詩詞的語言文字之表現方式獨特形態，以提高其 對詩詞文學的認識。 2、指導學生認識中國詩詞傳統文化對當今華人社會與文化的影響與意義。 3、指導學生掌握中國詩詞所展現的情感與哲思，闡發其精神，以達到古今相通、古為 今用的目的。 4、指導學生對古典詩詞具有鑒賞、感動的能力，能認識古典詩歌的整體美感，體味其 中之情，領悟文字之美，想像如畫之境。 2 5、指導學生賞識重要詩詞作家獨特的風格所形成的人格範式與性情典型，以現代心理 的視角來解讀古代詩人，進而透過古典詩作幽微之美共情現代人心。 三、課程內容與各週進度(實際授課時，將視課程進度、同學接受與學習 的情形會進行彈性的調整或安排) 第一週 2/23 課程簡介、認識同學與交流、中國詩歌的文體特質 (一)詩在人類世界中的永恆價值、(二)詩的文體特質為何 第二週 3/2 詩、詞的文體差異——以崔護〈題都城南莊〉、歐陽脩〈生查子〉為 例說明短暫化作永恆的人生情境 第三週 3/9 中國最早詩歌總集《詩經》的〈召南‧摽有梅〉、〈秦風‧蒹葭〉欣賞 第四週 3/16 百姓的生活圖卷——漢代樂府〈上山采蘼蕪〉的家庭倫理敘事 第五週 3/23 等待的心情——漢末五言古體冠冕「古詩十九首」之〈行行重行行〉、 〈青青河邊草〉欣賞 第六週 3/30 英雄與霸主的政治情懷--曹操的〈短歌行〉欣賞 第七週 4/6 放假 (原本進度:在時間中展現感情的變化——陸游〈釵頭鳳〉、〈沈 園〉中的負歉情結) 第八週 4/13 透過大自然來消解自己的孤獨——李白〈獨坐敬亭山〉、〈月下獨酌〉 第九週 4/20 當你見不到對方時，要如何透過距離來展現相思的深度呢——杜甫 〈月夜〉、李之儀〈卜算子〉欣賞 第十週 4/27 景中有情，情中有思：自然詩中的生活哲理——王維〈終南別業〉、 楊萬里〈桂源舖〉欣賞 第十一週 5/4 詞文體特質介紹——(一)詞和流行歌曲的關係、(二)詞和詩有何不同 第十二週 5/11 談自愛—溫庭筠〈菩薩蠻〉(小山重疊金明滅)；談勇氣——韋莊〈思 帝鄉〉（春日遊） 第十三週 5/18 風雨意象之於人生的象徵——李煜〈虞美人〉（春花秋月何時了）、〈相 見歡〉（林花謝了春紅）的身世之感 第十四週 5/25 如何超越人生的困境——蘇軾〈定風波〉（莫聽穿林打葉聲）、〈水調 歌頭〉(明月幾時有) 第十五週 6/1 同學期末作業與分享交流——一首我最喜愛的詩(或詞) 第十六週 6/8 同學期末作業與分享交流——一首我最喜愛的詩(或詞) 總結中國詩詞文體的文學價值與文化歷史意義 四、上課方式 學期前四分之三由老師講授，包括對詩學體系的介紹、詩法的演示，詩作的分析。 作品的分析，著重在詩家生平、詩風特色、詩史地位、詩歌意境。每首作品皆提供： 3 白話譯文、主要意象提示和作品的賞讀 學期後四分之一的課程由同學一位位上台報告、與台下同學交流，老師講評。 五、教材 老師自編講義 六、成績考核 1、出席率：10％ 第三週 3/9 日開始點名，以同學親自簽到的方式進行。同學若在上課當日因病或 事無法出席，應於上課前向老師請假(除非不得已，盡量不要在上課之後)。可透過學 校正式的請假系統，也可以只用寫信、私訊或電話簡訊。 因上課實際週數已經很少了(只有 15 週)，請同學不要經常性的多次請假) 2、預習情況與課堂參與表現：10％ 老師會在每次上課前就把下週要上課的簡報或講義發給或放在 eeclass 數位學習 平台上提供同學先行閱讀，要請同學搭配文本進行事前的預習，老師會用抽問的方式 來評估同學的學習情況，評量重點以理解內容與參與討論為主，不以語音流暢度為主 要評分依據。 3、 平時的測驗評量 35％ (本課程會定期舉行 2-3 次小考或一次期中考，考試方式和 題型將視課程進度、同學學習情形彈性調整或安排)。 4、上台報告與期末作業：共計 45％ (「一首詩(或詞)的啟示—選擇一首對自己生命有 深刻意義與啟示的詩作，並在報告和作業中說明原因與自己的體驗心得。) 本作業的重點不是在請同學分析作品的意涵，而是透過你個人的生活經驗和生命感 受來表達這首詩詞對你生命的啟示或意義。 配合課程專業性質，同學所選擇的作品，原則上是以中國古典詩詞為主，不限於課 堂上老師介紹過的作家或作品，也可以是你自己堂下接觸或閱讀過的(這樣更好)。 但如果同學因個人的學習狀況或條件背景，對選擇中國的詩詞進行報告感到困難， 可以私下向老師說明原委，則老師也可以通融個別同學，選擇自己的國家或地區的 古典詩詞來報告和作業。但同學則必須在報告時要更詳細的對你所選自己國家的作 品進行分析，幫助大家更好的理解) 本項成績共分兩個階段進行評分： (1)期中上台報告(20%) 學期最後二至三週為作業報告分享活動，每位同學透過設計簡報在課堂上口頭 報告對這首詩的感受和心得(佔分 20%) 每位同學的口頭報告以 10-15 分鐘為原則，報告內容包含對詩詞的作者介紹、 作品的創作背景和情境、詩詞的內容解說、自己的心得與體會等）。同學若對自己的 報告有疑慮的話，在報告之前，可以先與來信與老師討論，讓老師先審看你報告的 4 文字初稿後提供意見給你。 我們規定每位報告的同學都必須在你報告前(至少兩天前、即上課日的前星期六 結束之前)把你的簡報上傳到 eeclass 數位學習平台上的討論區，提供老師和同學先 行閱讀。 (2)學期末把報告增衍為一篇完整的閱讀心得(25%) 在課程結束後 6 月 15 日之前把這份報告更加深入詳細的推衍成為一篇文章 (25%)。 同學必須在期末課程結束後第 17 週再把期中報告寫成一篇文章，老師會為每一分 作業寫下評語和回饋給同學）。 七、生成式人工智慧倫理聲明 經考量，本課程的內容於生成式 AI 中尚有諸多錯誤，且容易影響學生對生命情感 教育與基礎知識之判讀。由於課程性質與內容乃以作品的情感、精神、生命理解為主， 不宜於此門課程當中使用生成式人工智慧於課堂學習當中，因此本課程禁止使用生成 式人工智慧，但允許使用線上字典與翻譯工具輔助理解原文，但不得用以生成報告、 心得或期末作業分析內容和自我表達。以下為相關的監管機制： 修讀本門課程之學生應注意本門課不得繳交使用生成式人工智慧所產出的作業、 報告或個人心得。若經查核發現，教師、學校或相關單位有權重新針對作業或報告重 新評分或不予計分。 修讀本課程之學生於選課時視為同意以上的倫理聲明。

docs.name: 心理學
docs.text: SUBJECT OUTLINE IEEM205000 心理學 General Psychology Delivery Spring 2026 Credit points 3 Result type Grade Subject Coordinator and Teaching Staff Dr. Chun-Hsiang (Michael) Chuang Email: ch.chuang@ie.nthu.edu.tw Course description: General Psychology introduces students to the scientific study of human thoughts, emotions, and behavior. This course provides a comprehensive overview of major psychological domains, including biological foundations, sensation and perception, learning, memory, development, motivation, personality, social behavior, and mental health. In addition to theoretical learning, students will gain practical experience by building and running real psychological experiments using PsychoPy or PsyToolkit. These hands-on activities allow students to connect classic psychological concepts with experimental design, human data collection, and basic behavioral analysis. By the end of the course, students will understand the core principles of psychology and develop foundational skills in experimental methods, critical thinking, and scientific inquiry. Keywords: Experimental Psychology, 實驗心理學, Cognitive Science, 認知科學, Human Factors and Ergonomics, 人 因 工 程 與 人 體 工 學 , Applied Behavioral Research, 應 用 行 為 研 究 , Psychophysiological Measurement, 心理生理量測, PsychoPy/PsyToolkit Marking: Assignments 30% Midterm exam 35% Final exam 35% Course schedule: Week Topic 1 Introduction to the Science of Mind and Behavior, Orientation; PsychoPy & PsyToolkit 2 How Psychologists Discover Knowledge; Stroop 3 Brain, Body, and Behavior: Biological Foundations; Simple RT / Choice RT 4 How We Sense and Interpret the World; Signal Detection Theory 5 Learning From Experience: Conditioning and Behavior Change; Conditioning Simulation 6 Consciousness, Sleep, and Everyday Awareness; PVT or CPT 7 Remembering and Forgetting: The Architecture of Memory; n-back 8 Midterm Exam 9 What Drives Us: Motivation and Goal-Directed Behavior; Reward–Response or Goal Priming 10 Stress, Coping, and Psychological Well-Being; Time-Pressure CPT/Math Stress 11 Thinking, Language, and Intelligent Behavior; Mental Rotation 12 How We Change: Development Across the Lifespan; Visual Preference or ToM Task 13 Understanding Personality and Individual Differences; Big Five Inventory 14 When Behavior Breaks Down: Psychological Disorders; Emotional Stroop 15 Helping People Change & How We Relate to Others; Stop Signal Task or Flanker 16 Final Exam References: Kearns, T., & Lee, D. (2015). General Psychology: An Introduction. University System of Georgia. Stoet, G. (2017). PsyToolkit: A novel web-based method for running online questionnaires and reaction-time experiments. Teaching of Psychology, 44(1), 24-31. Peirce, J. W. (2007). PsychoPy - Psychophysics software in Python. Journal of Neuroscience Methods, 162 (1-2): 8-13. Ethics statement on generative Artificial Intelligence: Grounded in the principles of transparency and responsibility, this course encourages students to leverage AI for collaboration and mutual learning to enhance the quality of course outputs. In accordance with the published Guidelines for Collaboration, Co-learning, and Cultivation of Artificial Intelligence Competencies in University Education, this course adopts the following policy: Conditionally open Students may briefly explain how generative AI was used for topic ideation, sentence refinement, or structural reference in the footnotes of the title page or after the bibliography in their assignments or reports. However, in the “personal reflection report” and “group interview assignment” of this course, students are not allowed to use generative AI tools for writing assignments. If usage is discovered without proper disclosure, instructors, the institution, or relevant units have the right to reevaluate the assignment or report or withhold scores. If the course materials or learning resources have been derived from generative AI, the instructor will also indicate this in the slides or orally. Students enrolled in this course agree to the above ethics statement if registering for the class.

docs.name: 作業研究二
docs.text: 1 Course: IEEM302000 Operations Research (II) Semester: Spring 2025 Number of credit hours: 3 Instructor: Professor Kuo-Hao Chang (chang@mx.nthu.edu.tw) Room 713R. docs.name: 產品設計與開發
docs.text: http://prl.ie.nthu.edu.tw/ R727, Product Realization Lab, National Tsing Hua University IEEM 3200 Product Design and Development Spring 2026 Instructors: 瞿志行 Room 823, 5742698 Class Time: Thursday 14:20-17:10 Course Website: eeclass TA: Textbook: Product Design and Development, K.T. Ulrich and S.D. Eppinger, McGraw Hill, 7th Edition. References: 1. Class-notes and related reading materials 2. Product Design, K. Otto and K. Wood, 2000, Prentice Hall Course Description: A product must make people’s life better by solving their pain points and/or problems by tangible or intangible solutions. This course introduces the basic concept, process, methodologies, and practices in new product development (NPD). Students are expected to learn fundamental knowledge in product design and development, to experience its interdisciplinary nature, and to position themselves in product value chain for future career. In order to achieve this goal, students in group must realize one product concept in a collaborative manner. This project aims to provide a real environment where students can experience and learn new product development in school environment. Each group is responsible for problem finding, marketing analysis, product planning, product specifications, product architecture, concept generation, engineering design, industrial design, prototyping, in addition to project management, scheduling control, cost management, and project coordination. The project execution and the final grading emphasize on both the process and the result. The execution details and processes during the project and the outcome produced at each stage must be recorded and well documented. All the discussion notes, decision factors, and related documents among team members should be preserved and will be graded. Project Description: Each project team consists of 5 students and each student plays one following role: Project Manager (PM), Marketing Specialist, Industrial Designer and Visualization Specialist, and Hardware/ Software Engineer (2). Note that the boundary and tasks of each role is not clearly defined (this is the nature in real industry). Many activities must be conducted by team, not individually. Each group needs to conceive a product concept, generate several sketches, and realize one design during the course of the project subject to functional, schedule, and budgetary constraints. In other words, students need to manage the project by properly controlling quality, time, scheduling, and cost. Each team has a budget around 2000 NTD including the manufacturing costs and purchase for all mechanical and electrical parts. A working prototype must be completed for each product idea. We will have a small demo at the last week. Each group will make a poster and display the prototype in this event. The final prototype must demonstrate the original design functions and comply with the product specifications proposed by each team. This course is not a typical engineering course conducted only via lectures, exams, and homework. We emphasize less on theories, but more on hand-ons, exposure, and learning of real-world experiences. Interdisciplinary design is the idea we want to promote throughout this class. Team http://prl.ie.nthu.edu.tw/ R727, Product Realization Lab, National Tsing Hua University collaboration is the key to the success of any product development. Thus, the grading will be determined by the process of the project running, team dynamics, and the final result. Grading: Homework 20% + Final Exam 35% + Final Prototype/Tradeshow 40% + Class/Team Participation 5% week activity 1 Introduction 2 Product Development Process 3 Product Planning (I) 4 Product Planning (II) 5 Customer Needs Analysis 6 Brainstorming Workshop 7 Product Specifications 8 User Experience Design 9 Prototyping Workshop (I) 10 Prototyping Workshop (II) 11 Product Architecture 12 Product Architecture Implications 13 Industrial Design 14 Final Exam 15 Design Thinking 16 Final Presentation

docs.text: 1 國立清華大學課程大綱-大學部 科號 IEEM4360 必/選修 選修 組別 人數限制 30 上課時間 W6W7W8; 2:20~5:20PM (週三 2:20~5:20PM) 教室 工程一館 203 室 總學分數 3 授課小時數 3 (Taught in English)數學 基礎科學 工程專業 理論 設計 0 0 2 1 科目中文名稱 電子商務 科目英文名稱 Electronic Commerce 任課教師 張瑞芬 教授 Prof Amy Trappey (*TA’s Tel: x33961; Lab: 726) 檔修科目 建議先修 ※下列各欄由任課教師提供※ 依 IEET 與評鑑精神,本系擬定之核心能力如下,教師請勾選本課程所欲培養之核心能力,並根據此建 立核心能力達成指標, 以課程評分量表(Rubrics)作為評估方法, 並依據此評分量表確認及評估教學成 效, 是否作後續教學改進之用。(課程對應之核心能力並非要求”全選”, 無對應到的核心能力”可以不 選”) 欲培養 之核心 能力 Core capability to be cultivated by this course □ Integration-將工業工程與工程管理各項技術整合應用，有效處理 工工領域相關議題 Abilities of integrating various technologies of Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management % ■ Information -資訊科技的善加應用, 以利解決工工領域之問題 Utilization of information technology to problem solving and applications in the field of Industrial Engineering 30 % □ Interaction-協調溝通與團隊精神的發揮 Coordination and communication abilities with teamwork % ■ Innovation/Ideas-激發創造力、培養創新思維 Creative and innovative capabilities 40 % ■ Internationalization-國際化互動與表達能力 Global interaction and public presentation skills 30 % 一、課 程說明 本課程的主要內容重點包括： 1. 管 理 導向 ： 強調 電子 商 務 在管 理 上的 應用 與 成 果， 並 指出 關鍵 技 術 之重 要 性 。E- commerce/e-business management – Strategic and operational perspectives. 2. 真實世界導向：討論實際的案例，使學生充份理解現實企業如何使用電子商務降低成本 與創新經營方式。Real world case studies. 3. 理論基礎：本課將講授 EC 基礎建設、EC 資安、EC 商業策略與應用、Mobile Commerce、 Social Media for EC、、等關鍵基礎理論與知識。E-commerce fundamentals: EC infrastructure, 2 EC security and privacy, EC business models, mobile commerce, social media commerce, digital marketing. 4. 創新電商智財、專利佈局：呈現的主題以近年被探討的重要 EC 創新議題，如社交網路電 商、EC 新商業模式、數位行銷、、等為主軸。State-of-the-art EC innovations, patents, and intellectual properties. 5. 系統整合：強調網際網路為基的 EC 系統整合特性，以利支援 B2C 零售及 B2B 虛擬企 業、供應鏈管理等應用。EC system integrations. 6. 全球觀點：電子商務促進跨國公司管理與全球電子化營運，本課程將以國際案例充份提 供全球 EC 創新觀點。Global EC operations, global logistics and supply chain management for EC. 二、指 定用書 Textboo k Title: E-Commerce 2023-2024: Business. Technology. Society (GE) Authors: Kenneth C. Laudon, Carol Guercio Traver I S B N - 13 ：9781292449722 I S B N -10: 1292449721 https://www.hwatai.com.tw/webc/html/book/show.aspx?isbn=1292449721&page=&Search=Book s&kw=E-Commerce%20Laudon V. 18 (2024) 三、參 考書籍 Related literature will be provided to all students. 四、教 學軟體 Software will be introduced with training sessions to all students. 五、教 學方式 課堂講解、課堂討論與個人報告 Lecture, Q&A discussion, and in-class presentations Generative AI tool can only be partially used for editing/refining your self-written reports and assignments ** 生成式 AI 有條件開放之規範註明：所有作業、報告皆需自己撰寫。 六、教 學進度 Lecture and Activity Schedule Week No. Core Topic Date 1 Ch01. Introduction to E-commerce 2/25 2 Ch02. E-commerce Business Strategies Ch03. E-commerce Infrastructure 3/4 3 Ch04. Building an E-commerce Presence 3/11 4 Ch05. Please complete your homework assignments and upload the files onto eeClass prior lecture hours. Course Briefing: 西元 2009～2010 年全球經濟危機，迫使組織精簡並減少其運作上的支出。2019~至今全球更深受 COVID 疫情(後疫情)以及全球政治經濟變動的影響，限制或改變了人類及企業的各項商務活動。例 如實施虛擬企業(內、外部)的各項作業、線上交易、虛擬實境下的溝通互動、、等等。人類生活中 重要的變革，多以「網路為基的社會」（internet-based society）之形成與普及來呈現。此一以網路為 基所發展出的各類應用大趨勢的快速增長，成就了全球電子商務 (E-Commerce)和電子化企業 (E- Business)的蓬勃發展。本課程的主要內容重點將包括電子商務的各項理論與實務，並著重在訓練同 學進入電子商務專業所需的基礎資訊技術和創新規劃能力。透過基礎理論學習、案例探討、專題實 作、口頭及書面報告，培養同學成為電子商務應用發展與規劃的專業人才。 The course will include key topics (but not limited to):  E-business management – Strategic and operational management, EC business models.  E-commerce fundamentals: EC infrastructure, EC security and privacy, EC business models, mobile commerce, social media commerce, digital marketing.  Real world case studies from the system integration perspectives.  State-of-the-art innovative EC topics.  Global EC operations: Global logistics and supply chain management for EC.

docs.text: SUBJECT OUTLINE IEEM523700 人類訊息處理 Human Information Processing Delivery Spring 2026 Credit points 3 Result type Grade Subject Coordinator and Teaching Staff Dr. Chun-Hsiang (Michael) Chuang Email: ch.chuang@ie.nthu.edu.tw Course description: Human Information Processing is a graduate-level course that examines the cognitive mechanisms underlying human performance and how these mechanisms can be quantified through physiological data analysis. The course teaches students how to engineer and process multimodal signals, such as EEG, ECG/HRV, and gaze, to assess workload, fatigue, vigilance, and decision-making in real-world systems. This engineering perspective supports the design of safer, more efficient, and human-centered work environments. Students will learn theories while simultaneously developing practical expertise in biomedical signal processing. Key engineering skills include preprocessing, artifact removal, digital filtering, time–frequency analysis, feature extraction, and source separation methods. Hands-on sessions will guide students through building complete processing pipelines using NeuroPype, Kubios, EEGLAB, MNE-Python, and Python/MATLAB tools. Real multimodal datasets will be used to investigate sustained attention, decision tasks, motor imagery, emotional asymmetry, workload, and cognitive fatigue. Students will further learn about functional connectivity, multimodal fusion, and machine learning approaches for cognitive state estimation and brain–computer interface development. By the end of the course, students will understand how the people processes information and how to engineer pipelines that process human physiological data, enabling them to interpret cognitive states and build small-scale (neuro)ergonomic systems. Keywords: Human Information Processing, Biomedical Signal Processing, EEG/ECG/Gaze Analysis, Brain–Computer Interfaces, Cognitive Neuroscience, Neuroergonomics Marking: Assignments 30% Midterm exam 35% Final project 35% Course schedule: Week Topic 1 Orientation & Introduction to Human + Data Processing 2 Basics of Biomedical Information 3 Biomedical Signal Processing, Time Domain Information 4 Cognitive Rhythms & Time–Frequency Analysis 5 Sustained Attention & Vigilance 6 Event-Related Potentials (ERP), Auditory and Visual Oddball Decision Making, RSVP 7 Motor Control & Motor Imagery 8 Midterm Exam 9 Visual Information Processing (SSVEP and Frequency-Based BCIs) 10 Resting-State Analysis, Connectivity, and Brain Networks 11 Emotion Processing & Frontal Asymmetry 12 Cognitive Workload, Fatigue, and Engagement 13 Advanced Source Analysis & Spatial Processing 14 Multimodal Fusion & Applied Neuroergonomics 15 Final Project Workshop 16 Project Presentation References: R. P. N. Rao, Brain-Computer Interfacing: An Introduction: Cambridge University Press, 2013. W. A. Awuah, A. Ahluwalia, K. Darko, V. Sanker, J. K. Tan, P. O. Tenkorang, et al., "Bridging Minds and Machines: The Recent Advances of Brain-Computer Interfaces in Neurological and Neurosurgical Applications," World Neurosurgery, vol. 189, pp. 138-153, 2024. Naik, G.R., & Santos, W.P.D. (Eds.). Biomedical Signal Processing: A Modern Approach (1st ed.). CRC Press, 2023. Ethics statement on generative Artificial Intelligence: Grounded in the principles of transparency and responsibility, this course encourages students to leverage AI for collaboration and mutual learning to enhance the quality of course outputs. In accordance with the published Guidelines for Collaboration, Co-learning, and Cultivation of Artificial Intelligence Competencies in University Education, this course adopts the following policy: Conditionally open Students may briefly explain how generative AI was used for topic ideation, sentence refinement, or structural reference in the footnotes of the title page or after the bibliography in their assignments or reports. However, in the “personal reflection report” and “group interview assignment” of this course, students are not allowed to use generative AI tools for writing assignments. If usage is discovered without proper disclosure, instructors, the institution, or relevant units have the right to reevaluate the assignment or report or withhold scores. If the course materials or learning resources have been derived from generative AI, the instructor will also indicate this in the slides or orally. Students enrolled in this course agree to the above ethics statement if registering for the class.

docs.text: 智慧化企業整合 Intelligent Integration of Enterprise (IIE) 課程大綱 Course Outline Time：R234 (9:00- Noon) Place： Eng-I 工一館 827 Instructor：邱銘傳 Prof. Ming-Chuan Chiu mcchiu@ie.nthu.edu.tw, Phone : #42699 Office: 923 (Hour: Wed. 10-12, email appointment preferred) Assistant：李衍函(Web/SQL)、蔡健得(APP: Android Studio) & 張承硯(Flexsim/AWS) #33949 Office: 913 (Hour: Fri. 9-12 & Mon 9-12, email appointment preferred) Objective 課程目的 This course introduces the modern integrated enterprises on the managerial and technical aspects of creating and managing modern IT enabled and integrated enterprises. It is clear that enterprises have been in rapid transition toward virtual enterprises with value chain integration for high efficiency and efficacy. Well-established management styles and business processes, based on hierarchical command and control structures, have been challenged both within an enterprise and between enterprises of value chains. Information systems are being realigned around business processes. The implementation of electronic commerce (or “e-business”) has become a key competence. Further, mobile phone applications empower the development of mobile application (APP). Recently, new Information technologies such as Clouding Computing, AR/VR, Cyber Physical System (CPS) serve as enabler of business intelligence to enhance enterprise competitiveness. This course provides such understanding by focusing on all aspects of managing this complex e-business processes, from strategic planning to the technologies of modern enterprise application integration. The course stresses the importance of hands-on and creative training. Students will be asked to complete a term project report/paper (3000~4000 words, not counting references, footnotes, and appendices) based on IIE concepts, techniques, and tools introduced during the lectures and tutorial trainings for practical applications and case studies. 本課程將介紹現代化企業管理面與科技面的結合，以及如何運用現代資訊科技管理達成虛擬企 業整合。企業為了追求更高效率與更高效能的價值鏈而快速地轉變成虛擬企業。以階層命令為主的 管理模式與控制結構，不論是企業內部還是企業外部，皆已改變。在企業流程內的資訊系統也開始 重新規劃，企業電子商務，或是稱為電子化企業，也已經變成企業生存最基本的要素，手機的興起， 讓手機應用程式 APP 成為日常生活最普遍的工具。此外新技術發展如雲端運算、虛擬(擴增)實境與 虛實整合系統等變成企業提升競爭力的推動器。這門課將會教導上述內容，並把焦點放在相關議題 的探討，從策略規劃到現代化科技應用整合等複雜的智慧化企業整合流程管理。這門課著重在問題 解決、分析報告、創新能力和相關資訊技術的訓練。在課程中，學生會被要求完成一個案例分析或 是一份與智慧化企業整合技術或工具相關的專題報告 (3000~4000 字，不含參考文獻與附錄)。 Reference 參考書籍-* 陳惠貞, 陳俊，PHP7&MySQL 跨裝置網站開發：超威範例集，碁峰出版社第二版 Hugh E.Welli & David Lance，PHP 與 MySQL 應用實務，歐萊禮出版社，第二版 湯秉翰，Android 實作這樣學: 使用 Android 8.1 與 Android Studio 3 秦天保&周向陽，實用系統仿真建模與分析--使用 Flexsim，清華大學出版社 Class Organization 教學方式 Lecture and discussion Homework and term project in groups Course material site: iLMS (http://lms.nthu.edu.tw/course/36006 ) Evaluation成績考核 Assignments: 25 points Midterm Exam: 15 points Group Project 1: 15 points (project report + oral presentation) Group Project 2: 15 points (project report + oral presentation) Individual Project 3: 15 points (project report + oral presentation) Class Participation: 15 points (Note: for homework and attendance, missing class without prior and official absence notification, 3 points will be deducted each time.) Topics 涵蓋主題 No. Core Topic 1 Introduction - Modern Integrated Enterprises 2 Architectural Planning, Business Process Modeling 3 Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) & Manufacturing Execution System (MES) 4 Product Data Management (PDM) & Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) 5 Enterprise Modeling – Examining Various Enterprise Views 6 Enterprise Process Modeling and Simulation Tool – Flexsim 7 Business Process Reengineering Techniques: TOC /VSM/IDEF 8 ER (Data) Model, SQL 9 Web for PC and Mobile(html/ php/chatbot) 10 Mobile APP Design 11 Case Studies (Term Projects) 12 New Topics Class Policies Late works, unexcused absences, cheating, plagiarism and non-professional behaviors (e.g., ringing mobile phone and eating in the class room) can result in a failed grade. docs.text: 課程資訊 及 課程大綱 課程名稱 (中文) 資訊安全實作二 課程名稱 (英文) Information Security Implementation II 科號 11420IIS 500300 授課教師 指導教授 上課時間 開課年級 資安所一年級、二年級 學分數 2 人數限制 先修科目 課程簡述 Brief Course Description (required) 本課程將由指導教授帶領，就資訊安全相關課程的理論與技巧，因 應個別學生之選題，應用在相關領域問題上並進行深入研究，以培 養解決資安問題之實作能力與閱讀學術論文的能力，並於期末繳 交心得報告。 關鍵字 資 訊 安 全 , 實 作 , 研 究 , Information Security, Implementation, Research 課程大綱 Detailed Course Syllabus 一、課程說明(Course Description) 本課程鼓勵學生就所習得之資訊安全相關課程的理論與技巧，因 應個別學生之選題，應用在相關領域問題上並進行深入研究，且 以研究簡報或撰寫報告之方式，以專門導向問題與指導教授共同 研究，以培養解決資安領域問題之實作能力，以及閱讀學術論文 的能力。 二、指定用書(Text Books) 由指導教授指定 三、參考書籍(References) 由指導教授指定 四、教學方式(Teaching Method) 學生在教授研究室學習各種研究技巧，解決研究上遭遇之問題。 五、教學進度(Syllabus) 由指導教授自行安排。 六、成績考核(Evaluation) 由研究報告素質、研究態度決定。 七、可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website) 核心能力 Core capability 請勾選 此科目對應之系所課程規畫所欲培養之核心能力 Core capability to be cultivated by this course 權重（百分比） Percentage 具備檢索文獻、閱讀論文、與撰寫論文的能力。 To be able to search literatures, read and write academic papers. 20 % 具有策劃及執行研究計畫、撰寫研究報告及簡報研究成果 的能力。 To be able to plan and execute research projects, write research reports, and present research results. 20% 瞭解與資訊安全相關之產業脈動與最新的資訊安全進展。 To understand the most recent technological and industrial advancements regarding information security. 20% 瞭解資訊安全對於全球性社會、經濟、文化等層面的影響 與責任。 To understand the social, economical, cultural effects of information security and related technologies on the global level. 20% 尊重學術、工程倫理、及智慧財產權。 To respect academics, engineering ethics, and intellectual property. 20%

docs.name: 密碼學設計與分析
docs.text: 課程資訊 及 課程大綱 課程名稱 (中文) 密碼學設計與分析 課程名稱 (英文) Cryptography Design and Analysis 授課教師 陳昱圻 上課時間 M234 （非同步課程） (如果要連續 3 小時上課，請一併提供理由。) 開課年級 研究所 學分數 3 人數限制 90 先修科目 無 課程簡述 Brief Course Description (required) Cryptography is a science used to design algorithms and formulate protocols for achieving security requirements, e.g. privacy, authentication, and data integrity. Recently, with the vigorous development of electronic communication and e-commerce, the importance of cryptography has gone beyond its historical military use. Cryptography provides technology to achieve security, for example: it allows us to successfully use credit cards for online transactions without revealing the card number to others. Over the past 25 years, cryptography has transformed from a technology developed for a specific purpose to a science with a solid theoretical foundation. This course will also teach the following directions of cryptography. 1. Definition: Cryptographic requirements (also known as cryptographic concepts) are formally defined to quantify the so-called security. 2. Cryptographic design and security proof: Cryptographic scheme design will be introduced, and its the security can be guaranteed by some difficult assumptions. 3. Theoretical basis: Cryptography schemes are all based on difficult assumptions. 4. Advanced topics (including post- quantum cryptography). (50-200 words if possible, up to 1000 letters / 最多 500 個中文字) 本欄位資料會上傳教育部課程網 關鍵字 Cryptography 密 碼 學 , Security definition 安 全 性 定 義 , Security analysis 安 全 性 分 析 , Cryptographic design 密 碼 學 設 計 , Post- quantum cryptography 後量子密碼學 請輸入課程內容「中文暨英文關鍵字」至少 5 個, 每個關鍵字至多 20 個中文, 以半形逗點分隔 (必填) Please fill in at least 5 course keywords (up to 40 letters for each keyword) and use commas to separate them.(required) 課程大綱 Detailed Course Syllabus 一、課程說明(Course Description) 密碼學是一門用來設計演算法和訂定協議的科學，目的為如何在 不安全的環境中達到安全的需求，如：隱私、認證、以及資料的完 整性。近期，在電子通訊和電子商務的蓬勃發展下，密碼學的重要 性已遠超越它在歷史上的軍事用途，而已經充滿在我們的生活當 中。非常重要的是密碼學提供了實現安全的技術，例如：它讓我們 可以成功使用信用卡於線上交易，同時又不洩漏卡號給其他人。 由過去 25 年來的進展，密碼學已經從一個為了達成特定目的所開 發的技術轉變成一門富有嚴謹理論基礎的科學。 二、指定用書(Text Books) Katz, Jonathan, and Yehuda Lindell. Introduction to modern cryptography. Chapman and Hall/CRC, 2014. 三、參考書籍(References) 自編教材 四、教學方式(Teaching Method) 非同步遠距授課 五、教學進度(Syllabus) 1. Intro to Crypto 密碼學簡介 2. Perfect Secrecy 完美秘密 3. Private Key Encryption 私密金鑰加密法 4. Message Authentication Code 訊息認證碼 5. Hash Functions 雜湊函數 6. Public Key Encryption 公開金鑰加密法 7. Digital Signatures 數位簽章 8. Other Advanced Topics 其他進階主題 六、成績考核(Evaluation) 平時小考、期中考、期末考 70% 小組報告 30% 七、可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website) https://hackmd.io/@wycchen/1132_Crypto_NTHU 核心能力 Core capability 請勾選 此科目對應之系所課程規畫所欲培養之核心能力 Core capability to be cultivated by this course 權重（百分比） Percentage 具有設計與操作實驗以及分析、解釋數據的能力。 To be able to design and perform experimentation as well as analyze and explain the experiment data. % v 具有發現問題、定義問題、並設計程式以解決問題的能 力。 To have the ability to discover problems, define them, and design computer programs to solve problems. 30% v 具有資訊、數學及科學的基礎知識。 To have fundamental knowledge of computer science, mathematics, and science. 30% v 具有分析、設計、開發、整合、測試、與評估資訊系統、 元件、或演算法的能力。 To be able to analyze, design, develop, integrate, test, and evaluate systems, components, and algorithms of computer science. 30% 具有良好的溝通技巧與跨領域團隊合作的能力。 To have good communication skills and be able to cooperate with others in interdisciplinary teams. % v 瞭解與資訊相關之產業脈動與最新的資訊科技進展。 To understand the most recent technological and industrial advancements regarding computer science. 10% 瞭解資訊科技對於全球性社會、經濟、文化等層面的影響 與責任。 To understand the social, economical, cultural effects of computer science and related technologies on the global level. % 瞭解國際視野及終身學習的重要性。 To understand the importance of international view as well as lifelong education. % 尊重學術、工程倫理、及智慧財產權。 To respect academics, engineering ethics, and intellectual property. %

docs.name: 系統設計軟體韌性
docs.nameEn: Software Design for Resilient Computer Systems
docs.text: 課程資訊 及 課程大綱 課程名稱 (中文) 系統設計軟體韌性 課程名稱 (英文) Software Design for Resilient Computer Systems 授課教師 陳殿河 上課時間 搭配系統 DEMO (如果要連續 3 小時上課，請一併提供理由。) 開課年級 大四、碩 學分數 3 人數限制 20 先修科目 課程簡述 Brief Course Description (required) 系統韌性設計，強調系統在遭受不預期事件後，仍能維持正常功能 並快速恢復的能力，是產品設計韌性的一種表現形式。 如何達到此系統軟體的設計目標，為此課程之重點，此外因應歐盟 的《網路韌性法》(Cyber Resilience Act, CRA) 要求軟體製造商採 取「設計安全」策略，並將資安要求融入開發過程，並對漏洞管理 做出規範，可知資訊安全與系統軟體韌性，已是全球關注之議題， 軟體系統設計時，除了須了解設計規格需求外，如何強化軟體設計 的安全性與其在遭遇威脅時的韌性，是更重要的議題。 此課程之目標，在建立軟體系統設計之安全意識觀念，輔以企業實 際案例，說明安全的軟體系統設計的重要性，並分析與說明設計軟 體系統的方法論。 網路安全專注於保護資訊資產免受未經授權的存取、使用、破壞， 而軟體韌性則強調系統在遭受網路攻擊等不預期事件後，仍能維 持正常功能並快速恢復的能力，是網路韌性的一種表現形式。 兩 者緊密相關，軟體韌性包含在資訊安全防護措施中，目的在確保系 統受威脅時，也能維持資訊的可用性與系統的營運。 關鍵字 資訊安全, 軟體韌性, 系統軟體, 網路韌性, 容錯演算法 Cyber Security, Software Resilience, System Software, Cyber Resilience, Fault Tolerance 課程大綱 Detailed Course Syllabus 一、課程說明(Course Description) 系統韌性設計，強調系統在遭受不預期事件後，仍能維持正常功能 並快速恢復的能力，是產品設計韌性的一種表現形式。軟體韌性包 含在資訊安全防護措施中，目的在確保系統受威脅時，也能維持資 訊的可用性與系統的營運。 如何達到此系統軟體的設計目標，為此課程之重點，歐盟的《網路 韌性法》(Cyber Resilience Act, CRA) 要求軟體製造商將資安要求 融入開發過程，並對漏洞管理做出規範，可知資訊安全與系統軟體 韌性，已是全球關注之議題，軟體系統設計時，除了須了解設計規 格需求外，如何強化軟體設計的安全性與其在遭遇威脅時的韌性， 是更重要的議題。 此課程之目標，在建立軟體系統設計之安全意識觀念，輔以企業實 際案例，說明安全的軟體系統設計的重要性，並分析與說明設計軟 體系統的方法論。 二、指定用書(Text Books) Software Design for Resilient Computer Systems 作者： Schagaev, Igor,Zouev, Eugene,Thomas, Kaegi 出版社：Springer 2024 三、參考書籍(References) 1. Balancing Coupling in Software Design: Universal Design Principles for Architecting Modular Software Systems 作者： Vlad Khononov 2. 軟體設計耦合的平衡之道：建構模組化軟體系統的通用設計原則 四、教學方式(Teaching Method) 投影片配合口述, Throughout the course, we will incorporate case studies to delve into essential supply chain metrics that are critical for assessing performance and making informed decisions. Students will learn about the primary trade-offs involved in supply chain decision-making, equipping them with the analytical skills necessary to navigate complex scenarios. Basic tools for effective and efficient supply chain management will be introduced, covering key areas such as production planning, inventory control, order fulfillment, and supply chain coordination. In addition to these foundational elements, we will explore advanced topics that are increasingly relevant in today’s global marketplace. This includes global supply chain design, where students will learn how to strategically structure supply chains to optimize efficiency and responsiveness. We will also examine logistics and outsourcing strategies, discussing how companies can leverage external partnerships to enhance their supply chain capabilities. Furthermore, the course will investigate several recent innovations in supply chain management, including the integration of technology and data analytics, which are transforming traditional practices and driving competitive advantage. By the end of this course, students will have gained a robust understanding of the complexities of supply chain management and will be well-prepared to apply their knowledge in real-world settings, docs.text: National Tsing Hua University College of Technology Management Course Syllabus 科號 Course Number 11420IMBA400500 學分 Credit 3 人數限制 Size of Limit 25 中文名稱 Course Title 新團隊的企業決策管理 英文名稱 Course English Title Business Decision Making for New Organization 任課教師 Instructor Yu-Wei Hsu 許祐維 Hung-Wen Chen 陳鴻文 教師聯絡方式 Contact Information Email: yhsu.edu@gmail.com 上課時間 Time R2R3R4 上課教室 Room CTM/TSMC Building & Gen Building II Computer Room 先修科目 Prerequisite(s) Accounting 關鍵字 Key Words (至少 5 個，請填寫中英文) 決策管理、新團隊、批判性思考、經營成果發表、經營決策模擬系 統。Decision Making, New Organization, Critical Thinking, Business Results Presentation, Business Decision Simulation System. 本課程對應之學習目標與核心能力 Aligned Learning Goals and Learning Objectives - Decision Making capability – be responsible and confident on making timely decisions in a new business and have good understanding how they relate to financial results. - Critical Thinking skills – be able to analyze complex business information and to make sound judgement. - Entrepreneurial Teamwork / Leadership – be able to lead and to collaborate with others effectively in a new organization that has additional constraints and uncertainties. 課程目標 Course Objectives - To understand the essential mindset and mental models to run a new organization that needs clear vision while capped with constrained resources. - To learn and practice the business decision making in new organization through collaborative work with team members in a Business Making Decision Simulation system. Participants will have the opportunities to play the roles of business leaders in simulated business competition. - To analyze business results based on simulated results – financials and non-financials. - To build up strong interactive capability in business group discussion - to provide useful feedback, challenges and to help driving the new organization to succeed. *We refer “new organization” as either an initially established startup or a new business team in a corporate. National Tsing Hua University College of Technology Management Course Syllabus 課程說明 Course Description - This course is useful for students who are interested in understanding the essentials in making business decisions in a new organization. Additionally, they will gain “hands-on” experience through simulated system. - Lectures on the critical elements of business decision making will be given. This helps the participants to have better understanding of the key managerial concept needed in running a new organization. - We will be using BattMan – Batter Management Tech Startup Simulation by Lumis to have simulated startup companies competing in a market. The participants will be acting as individual business founders to make various decisions while communicating closely among themselves in their simulated companies. It involves the decisions from product development, resource acquiring, production, sales & marketing, funding (angel & VC), etc. There will be a tutorial session when we start using the simulation to facilitate the use of such simulation. Reviews will be conducted after the simulation to pick up successful factors and areas for improvements. - The course will be run through the combinations of lectures, business simulation and group discussions. Near the end of the class, business presentation and result reviews will be conducted. With these arrangements, the participants will be more capable of applying the management concept in real life new business. It is also similarly critical for them to learn vividly on why a new organization could easily fail in bad decisions. In another words, it is much better to learn such failures in a class than in real life. *Please note that each participant will need to pay NT$1100 for using the BattMan Simulation system. 指定用書 Textbooks Jim Marteney, “Arguing Using Critical Thinking” OpenStax (Rice University), “Principles of Management” 參考書籍 References Charles Koch, “Good Profit” 教學方式 Teaching Approach a) Lectures. b) “BattMan” Business Simulation – an online multi-user business simulation system that the students will be assigned roles and teamed up in different starting up companies competing for financial results. c) Simulation Result Team Presentation and Review. d) Team discussions. - After each simulation, the team may need to discuss (online possible) for key learnings. - At the end of the whole class, a Final Presentation package is to be submitted by each team. * We may be moving to the Computer Room at certain weeks. National Tsing Hua University College of Technology Management Course Syllabus 評分標準 Grading Class participation, group discussions and personal contribution in the Simulation: 30% Lecture reflection: 20% - By the end of selected lectures (or within given days), a feedback form is to be submitted with feedback and key learning. Business Decision Making Simulation Competition Result: 20% - Simulated metrics such as founders’ values will be used to rate the result (competition ranking). Final Presentation & Review: 30% - The key learning and reflection from analyzing the competition result is more critical than merely having a great competition result of the team. Grading may differ among the members within a team based on individual contribution. 教學進度 Course Schedule Week Date Topic 1 Feb 26 Introduction 2 Mar 05 Critical Thinking Foundations for New Organizations 3 Mar 12 Structuring Decisions: Issues, Assumptions & Evidence 4 Mar 19 Effective Communication & Alignment in New Teams 5 Mar 26 Building and Defending Strong Arguments 6 Apr 02 <holiday> 7 Apr 09 Reasoning Quality: Logic, Fallacies & Biases 8 Apr 16 Invited Speech or Site Visit 9 Apr 23 Decision Pitfalls & Group Dynamics in New Organizations 10 Apr 30 Business Decision Making Simulation – Getting Started 11 May 07 Business Decision Making Simulation – Practice Round 12 May 14 Business Decision Making Simulation – Competition 13 May 21 Invited Speech or Site Visit 14 May 28 Final Presentation & Review – wk1 15 Jun 04 Final Presentation & Review – wk2 16 Jun 11 Overall Review & Reflection  In case needed especially in considering the class reflection, adjustment will be made. 課程相關連接 Course Related Links N/A 生成式人工智慧倫理聲明 Ethics Statement on Generative Artificial Intelligence Conditionally Open: Students must briefly explain how generative AI was used for topic ideation, sentence refinement, or structural reference in the footnotes of the title page or after the reference in their assignments or reports. If usage is discovered without proper disclosure, instructors, the institution, or relevant units have the right to reevaluate the assignment or report or withhold scores. If the course materials or learning resources have been derived from generative AI, the instructor will also indicate this in the slides or orally. Students enrolled in this course agree to the above ethics statement if registering for the class.

docs.text: National Tsing Hua University College of Technology Management Course Syllabus 科號 Course Number IMBA400700 學分 Credit 3 人數限制 Size of Limit 30 中文名稱 Course Title 金融市場工具的實際運用 英文名稱 Course English Title How to Monetize Capital Market Instruments 任課教師 Instructor 陳柏全 (Johnny Chen) 教師聯絡方式 Contact Information +886979095862, johnny@csm-capital.com 上課時間 Time F2F3F4 上課教室 Room TSMC 430 先修科目 Prerequisite(s) Prior Corporate Finance and Investments coursework will help the student comprehend the core values of this course better 關鍵字 Key Words (至少5個，請填寫中英 文) Investment Management 投資管理 Hedge Funds Strategies 對沖基金策略 Fixed Income Strategies 固定收益策略 Financial Arbitrage 金融套利 Capital Structure 資本結構 本課程對應之學習目標與核心能力 Aligned Learning Goals and Learning Objectives The main goal is to enable students to apply and adapt their corporate finance learnings to analyze how important concepts and principles actually manifest through a seminar approach of examining modern day events, and how these instruments can be monetized. The student after this course should have a keen awareness of how various parts of the capital structure (high yield debt, investment grade debt, preferred shares and equity) effect capital market decisions and shape modern economies and corporate balance sheets. In essence, this course puts the student into positions of fund manager, CFO, and central bank policy makers and enables them to apply their corporate finance learnings in actuality by examining these instruments at work around them. The student should learn how to think critically, apply theories pragmatically, compare financial solutions objectively, and be aware of liability management. 課程目標 Course Objectives To impart on the student the ability to - Understand the root cause of financing problems facing governments and corporations - Dissect the problem and identify the right tools to frame the problem - Apply the appropriate capital market tool to solve various financial conundrums - Communicate the solutions succinctly and cogently - Most importantly, recognize how to capture value through financial instruments National Tsing Hua University College of Technology Management Course Syllabus 課程說明 Course Description Everyday, major financial market news fill TV screens and websites and social media. But rarely is the audience aware of the impact these events are having on the world around them and how to frame these events and impacts in a way that separates the financially knowledgeable and the non-financially savvy. The course is designed in the format of bringing real world financial cases into the classroom, and through this course enable students to become financially savvy and be on the lookout to apply their theoretical knowledge toward achieving profitably financial outcomes. It will consist of 16 weeks of lectures done in seminar format, with as much contemporary material incorporated as feasible, with up to 2 corporate visitations (availability pending), one during mid-term, and one near term end. Each week’s topic will incorporate one part of the capital market instrument and the intent is to cover the entire capital structure spectrum. 指定用書 Textbooks There is no required textbook for this course, but the following would enhance the student’s understanding of basics underlying the course. - Tim Koller, Marc Goedhart, David Wessels and McKinsey & Co., Valuation: Measuring and Managing the Value of Companies, 7th Edition, Wiley. 參考書籍 References - Robert Dubil, Financial Engineering and Arbitrage in the Financial Markets, 2nd Edition, Wiley. - Donald H. Chew, The New Corporate Finance: Where Theory Meets Practice, 3rd Edition, McGraw-Hill. 教學方式 Teaching Approach The approach will be a seminar style with lecture notes and class participation in a collaborative way and sometimes in a debate format between teams of students, accompanied with topical discussions 評分標準 Grading The course will grade on the following weightings: - 40% on class participation - 20% First team presentation - 20% Second individual presentation - 20% on Final individual presentation AI使用規則 Use of AI The purpose of this course is to monetize on knowledge – use of AI is encouraged if such use can generate additional alpha and increase Sharpe ratio. docs.text: Course Title: Research Methods and Data Analysis (IMBA501000) Course Description: This course provides an introduction to the principles and practices of academic and applied research in management and the social sciences. Students will explore how to design research, collect and analyze data, and interpret findings from both qualitative and quantitative perspectives. Emphasis is placed on linking real-world issues to theoretical frameworks and developing a solid foundation for independent research or thesis work. Course Objectives: By the end of the course, students should be able to: ● Formulate clear and researchable questions. ● Understand key research philosophies and approaches. ● Design and conduct basic qualitative and quantitative studies. ● Analyze data and interpret findings appropriately. ● Develop a coherent research proposal grounded in theory. Course Format: Lectures, discussions, group exercises, and student presentations. Active participation and independent reading are expected. Assessment Overview: ● Participation and class discussion: 40% ● Research idea sharing: 10% ● Research idea proposal: 20% ● Final research proposal and presentation: 30% Suggested Readings: ● Creswell, J. (2018). Research Design: Qualitative, Quantitative, and Mixed Methods Approaches. ● Saunders, M., Lewis, P., & Thornhill, A. (2019). docs.name: 國際學校華語教學之理論與實務
docs.nameEn: Chinese Teaching and Learning in the International School
docs.text: 1 Chinese Teaching and Learning in the International School Context: Theory and Practice 國際學校華語教學之學理與實務 Instructor: Helen Jou, Ph.D. 李秀芬博士 Course Description This course aims to engage students in exploring the fundamentals of the teaching and learning in the unique context of an international school. Course sessions facilitate the students to construct a general yet comprehensive understanding of the theories and practice required of a teacher in such setting, and to develop a concrete idea of what it takes to be a competent international school educator. Class meetings consist of lectures, pair/group/class discussions, mini-lesson design, micro-teaching and presentations. Learning Objectives With taking this course, the students are expected to develop an understanding of the uniqueness of teaching and learning in an international school and an ability to integrate it into lesson planning and teaching by achieving the following objectives. No Objectives Assessment Tasks 1 Understand the motivational ARCS Model and its critical impact on teaching and learning. Design and present a motivational learning activity using the ARCS Model with effective strategies in class management and integrate the key elements in IB philosophy with conceptual and contextual learning. 2 Understand the mentality, the positive approaches and effective strategies in class management for success 3 Understand IB philosophy, including the Mission Statement, the Learner Profile, the ATLs and the ATTs, that guides IB teaching and learning 4 Understand conceptual and contextual learning in Concept-based Curriculum and Instruction (CBCI) Design and present a Chinese mini lesson integrating conceptual and contextual learning, the AP Chinese features and teaching approaches that meet the AP Chinese learning goals and assessment requirements, with different forms of assessments (including “of”, “for” and also “as” learning). 5 Understand the philosophy, key components and framework with effective teaching strategies of AP Chinese curriculum and instruction 6 Understand assessment for learning including SOLO, UbD and UDL 2 7 Understand the concepts and approaches of CPD (Continuing Professional Development) and its impact on teaching and learning Explore, design and present a personal CPD plan to map out future personal and professional growths and engage in lifelong learning. Course Credits / Course Requirements This is a 3-credit course. Previewing of the assigned reading and class participation are both required. Course Structure This course is inquiry-supported, student-centered, theory-enriched and practice-based. Through guided inquiry in each session, students first explore and construct a general understanding of the uniqueness of an international school context as the mental framework for learning, then substantiate it with theories and examples through the following lectures, discussions and practices to construct a comprehensive understanding of what is required of a competent international schoolteacher. Contextual factors such as motivational design and class management which play a significant role in the effectiveness of teaching and learning are introduced and explored; instructional factors including AP Chinese, which is commonly a part of an international school curriculum, and IB philosophy in teaching and learning, which is a key component in many international IB schools, are addressed; current trend of the assessment and the features that differ from traditional formats are investigated with the philosophy of Differentiation, Understanding by Design (UbD) and Universal Design for Learning (UDL); latest teaching and learning theory and practice of Concept- based Curriculum and Instruction (CBCI) is introduced focusing on conceptual and contextual learning. To facilitate students in developing the ability to grow professionally and continuously, various formats and approaches of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) are explored and the designing of a personal CPD plan is practiced to ensure the beginning of a lifelong learning journey. 3 Class Schedule Session/Date Topic Content 1. 2/25 Introduction An introductory session to the unique context of an international school 2. 3/4 Motivational Design (Keller, 2010) i. Theory: understand the ARCS Model (Keller, 2010), the key elements of the Motivational Design for Learning and Performance, and the critical impact it has on teaching and learning. 3. 3/11 Class Management (Fred Jones, ii. Theory: understand the teacher’s mentality for success in class management; learn and develop the positive approaches and effective strategies in class management. 4. 3/18 IB philosophy in teaching and learning iII. Theory: understand the general philosophy that guides IB teaching and learning, including the Mission Statement, the Learner Profile, the ATLs and the ATTs. 5. 3/25 1st Micro- teaching (Group) iv. Practice: design and present a motivational Chinese-learning activity using effective strategies in class management and the ARCS Model with the key elements of teaching and learning in IB philosophy. 6. 4/1 CBCI 4 7. 4/8 Reflective learning and constructive feedback 8. 4/15 Volition Session (from Theory to Practice) 9. 4/22 Concept-based Curriculum and Instruction (CBCI) i. Theory: Understand the latest trend of Concept- based Curriculum and Instruction (CBCI, Erickson, 2017) focusing on the structure of knowledge/process, conceptual understanding and contextual learning 10. 4/29 AP Chinese ii. Theory: understand the philosophy, key components and framework of AP Chinese curriculum and the AP Exam, and learn effective teaching strategies. 11. 5/6 Assessment iii. Theory: understand the trends in assessments as assessment for learning including Differentiation, UbD and UDL 12. 5/13 2nd Micro- teaching(Group or individual) iv. Practice: design and present a Chinese mini lesson integrating conceptual and contextual learning, the AP Chinese features and teaching approaches that meet the AP Chinese learning goals and assessment requirements, with different forms of assessments (including “of”, “for” and also “as” learning). 13. 5/20 14. 5/27 Reflective learning and constructive feedback 15. 6/3 Continuing Professional Development 16. 6/10 Final Exam / Complete a personal plan of CPD Readings and learning resources All students must read and explore the following resources. 1. Understanding India’s diplomacy has therefore become increasingly imperative, as the country now plays a greater role in shaping the geopolitical dynamics of the Indo-Pacific and the broader world order. India’s foreign policy decisions have far-reaching implications for regional stability, economic development, and the shifting balance of power among major nations. To provide a comprehensive understanding of India’s position in the international system, this course will examine its relations with major powers, neighboring states, and key regions. 中文暨英文關鍵 字（五組） 印度研究、印度外交政策、印度對外關係、國際關係 India Studies, India’s foreign policy, India’s foreign relations, International Relations 課程大綱 Detailed Course Syllabus ● 課程說明(Course Description) ● 指定用書(Text Books) 1. docs.name: 太空輻射與電子元件測試
docs.nameEn: Space Radiation and Electronic Component Testing
docs.text: 國立清華大學課程大綱 科號 Course Number 學分 Credit 人數限制 Class Size 中文名稱 Course Title 太空輻射與電子元件測試 英文名稱 Course English Title Space Radiation and Electronic Component Testing 任課教師 Instructor 蕭棟元 上課時間 Time 上課教室 Room 課程簡述(必填) (最多 500 個中文字) 本欄位資料會上傳教育部課程網 本課程探討太空環境中的輻射特性及其對電子元件的影響,涵蓋輻射與物質交互作用的基礎理 論、半導體元件的輻射效應、測試方法與標準、以及輻射測試設計與數據分析。課程將介紹銀 河宇宙射線、太陽粒子事件與捕獲輻射等太空輻射源,探討總游離劑量、位移損傷劑量與單一事 件效應等關鍵概念。學生將學習國際測試標準(如 MIL-STD-883、ESCC)、輻射測試設施的使用、 以及 SPENVIS、OMERE 等建模工具的應用。課程包含衛星任務案例研究,並要求學生完成針對特 定電子元件的輻射測試計畫設計或小型研究報告。 Brief Course Description (required) (50-200 words if possible, up to 1000 letters) 課程內容「中文暨英文關鍵字」(必填) 至少 5 個,每個關鍵字至多 20 個中文,以半形逗點分隔 Please fill in at least 5 course keywords (up to 40 letters for each keyword) and use commas to separate them.(required) 太空輻射,電子元件測試,單一事件效應,總游離劑量,輻射加固,Space Radiation,Electronic Component Testing,Single Event Effects,Total Ionizing Dose,Radiation Hardening 課程大綱(必填)Detailed Course Syllabus ● 課程說明(Course Description) This course provides a comprehensive introduction to space radiation environments and their effects on electronic components used in spacecraft and satellite systems. Students will learn about the fundamental physics of radiation-matter interactions, the various types of radiation damage mechanisms, and industry-standard testing methodologies. The course covers galactic cosmic rays (GCR), solar particle events (SPE), trapped radiation belts, and their impacts on semiconductor devices including CMOS, bipolar transistors, and power electronics. Emphasis is placed on understanding Total Ionizing Dose (TID), Displacement Damage Dose (DDD), and Single Event Effects (SEE), as well as practical radiation testing techniques using particle accelerators, gamma sources, and X-ray facilities. Students will gain hands-on experience in test planning, dosimetry, data analysis, and the use of modeling tools such as SPENVIS, OMERE, and GEANT4. ● 指定用書(Text Books) No single required textbook. Course materials will be provided through lecture notes and selected journal articles. ● 參考書籍(References) 1. Holmes-Siedle, A., & Adams, L. (2002). Handbook of Radiation Effects (2nd ed.). Oxford University Press. 2. Messenger, G. C., & Ash, M. S. (1997). The Effects of Radiation on Electronic Systems (2nd ed.). Van Nostrand Reinhold. 3. Leroy, C., & Rancoita, P. G. (2016). Principles of Radiation Interaction in Matter and Detection (4th ed.). World Scientific. 4. Selected papers from IEEE Transactions on Nuclear Science and relevant conference proceedings. ● 教學方式(Teaching Method) Lectures, case study discussions, hands-on data analysis exercises, and student presentations. Students will work on a final project involving either a literature review or the design of a radiation test plan for a selected electronic component. ● 教學進度(Syllabus) Week 1-2: Introduction to Space Environment Week 3-4: Radiation-Matter Interaction Fundamentals Week 5-6: Effects on Semiconductor Devices Week 7-8: Testing Methods and Standards Week 9-10: Radiation Test Design Week 11-12: Data Collection and Analysis Week 13-14: Case Studies Week 15-16: Final Project Presentations and Report Submission ● 成績考核(Evaluation) Homework assignments: 30% Midterm exam: 25% Final project (report + presentation): 35% Class participation: 10% ● 採用下列何項 AI 使用規則(Indicate which of the following options you use to manage student use of the AI) 完全開放使用且無須註明 Unrestricted use with no disclosure required 可參考下列網頁範例 See the following web page for examples. https://curricul.site.nthu.edu.tw/p/404-1208-248357.php?Lang=zh-tw ● 可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website)

docs.nameEn: Explorers of Light: Science, Technology & Artistic Innovation
docs.text: 11420 IPHD500100 跨院博密集課程 - 國立清華大學 114 學年下學期 (2026-04) 光之探索者:科學、技術與藝術創新 Explorers of Light: Science, Technology & Artistic Innovation Le Photon dans tous ses états : Science, Technologie et Innovation artistique 授課老師: 陳珠櫻教授、李瑞光教授 上課日期地點: 2026/04/22(三)清大旺宏館-大半圓 | 2026/04/26(日)清大校本部-綜二 204 課程學分: 1 學分(16 小時) 授課語言: 英文/中文 關鍵詞: 印象派、攝影藝術、科技藝術、量子藝術、人工智慧、集體智慧(臺灣半導體先驅) Impressionism, Photography, Art & Technology, Quantum Art, Artificial Intelligence, Collective Intelligence (Taiwan Semiconductor Pioneer) 課程介紹與教學方式 (2 天密集式工作坊)： 本課程將探討光子在科學研究、藝術創作與科技創新中的多重面向。透過跨領域的方式，尋訪光 在現代物理學(量子)、視覺藝術(繪畫、攝影)及科技藝術(虛擬/擴增實境)的表現、應用與想像。 引領大家穿越光子的各種狀態，這個難以捉摸的粒子 : 宇宙的信使、影像的因緣、生命能量的泉 源。在藝術、科學與科技的交會處，我們探索「光」如何成為語言(繪畫)、工具(科學)、意涵(思 想) 與象徵(精神)。 教學方式兼顧實地體驗與理論探究；活動內容包括參觀為清大在台創校七十週年校慶舉辦的台法 藝術交流展與對談，同時 2026 年亦是攝影技術問世 200 週年之際（法國人發明），特邀法國講者 介紹當代攝影藝術。 第一天 : 參觀台法交流展，展覽主題 : 《一粒砂、一滴水、一世界》和演講座談:《矽島的故事》(論壇議 題 : 晶片生產與西方依賴、人才挑戰與前瞻研發、及藝術為跨界的共通語言)。 陳珠櫻 Chu-Yin Chen, 掘金記憶 / Data Mining ©2023 旅法的台灣藝術家陳珠櫻構思的《掘金記憶》Data Mining，融合擴增實境技術，在一個開放式的 展覽空間呈現一座象徵性的《數位拓荒者名人堂》。由鑲嵌半導體機板組合而成的「藍染影像地 毯」，呼應臺灣島的海洋地理風情及對早期首要工業 - 紡織業的文化記憶情懷。觀眾透過手機或 平板掃描封裝記憶的「圖碼」，進入作品所構築的訪談空間，探索臺灣半導體產業先驅所開創的 「人工記憶技術」及「人民集體智慧」的奠基歷程。這座數位化的名人堂文本，不僅詮釋當代數 位科技的源起與演進，更締造一種嶄新的人史敘事方式。本作品結合敘事藝術與科技創新，邀請 觀眾重新思考數位轉型時代中知識的形塑方式，並見證臺灣在全球半導體科技發展中的關鍵地位。 2 / 2 妲芬妮 Daphné Le Sergent, 艾略特浪濤 / Elliott’s Waves ©2023 韓裔法國藝術家妲芙妮•樂司晨創作的《艾略特浪濤》Elliott’s Waves，探討數據循環的生態系統。 作品名稱源自艾略特波動理論，象徵當今 AI 崛起所帶動的全球經濟與科技動能，進而折射出其波 動與脆弱。AI 生成的擬真世界 -「浪濤影像水墨」，不再是現實的映照，而是融入大數據的迴圈， 奔向全球經濟的洪流；當 AI 創作本身捲入經濟投機的浪潮，引發對未來泡沫經濟及潛在資訊危機 的深刻反思。數據與水，皆為當代社會不可或缺的資源，作品以詩意對照呈現:人類數據的洪流與 自然界水的循環相互映照-正如數位語彙中常見的意象:「Navigator 瀏覽者」、「Surfing 衝浪」、 「Cloud 雲端」、「Data Lake 資料湖」等，並提醒我們在邁向科技中審視人類與自然的共生關係。 第二天 : 兩個世紀前人類首次以光為筆，時間為紙，將瞬間凝結為永恆。這項改變人類歷史記憶與創作方 式的偉大發明紀念之年，我們邀請法國講者(大巴黎攝影藝術中心主任)及藝術家(巴黎第八大學攝 影系主任)，介紹攝影技術及當代攝影藝術家，這些作品不僅是對光影的探索，更是對觀看、記憶 與存在的深層提問。這將是一場穿越時空的凝視之旅 : 讓我們一同走進光的縫隙，傾聽影像低語， 感受攝影如何在技術與詩意之間、凝視與顯影之間，開啟深刻的剎那感知經驗。 課程內容旨在提供一個自由思辨與創作想像的空間，透過研究者、藝術家與科學家交匯的視角， 共同探索光子的各種狀態，從不可見到可見，從量子光學到詩意影像。 其內容分兩大思考主軸： 光與現代物理量子 — 量子力學（含光量子現象和理論）與創新科技應用: 科學家如何建構微觀 的模型？科技如何改變我們對現實的感知？ 光與視覺藝術創作 — 印象派與攝影藝術的表現手法: 攝影師如何將可見的瞬息現象化為歷久不 衰的印記 ? 藝術家如何感召不可見的事物並將其轉化為非形式的表現？ 核心能力的培養： 非線性與挑戰傳統邏輯的思考方式 ; 跨域合作、對未知的好奇心，勇於實驗與探索的精神。 成績考核 上課出席狀況 (必須全程出席) : 30% 。 分組討論報告(參與度與創意思維) : 30%。 心得感想撰寫: 40% (中文為主，A4 紙至少 2 頁 ，字體大小 12，每頁至少 1000 字) 。 學生使用 AI 的規則：本門課程採取禁止使用。 3 / 2 第一天 工作坊 國立清華大學在台七十週年校慶 | 台法合作交流展覽暨論壇 展覽主題: 一粒砂・一滴水・一世界 展覽日期|地點: 2026/04/21（二）– 04/28（二） 清大 旺宏館 穿堂 開幕時間|地點: 2026/04/22（三）10:00 清大 旺宏館 穿堂 論壇議題: 矽島的故事 論壇時間|地點: docs.name: 偏最小平方結構方程模型於教育研究的應用
docs.nameEn: Understanding and Applying Partial Least Square-Structural Equation Modeling in Educational Studies
docs.text: Lecture NTHU / Spring 2026 / 1 credit /16 hours. Course Title: 國際密集課程/ International Intensive Course Time:2026/3/21-2026/3/29 Lecturer: Lei Mee THIEN National Higher Education Research Institute & School of Educational Studies Universiti Sains Malaysia 課程大綱 (Syllabus) 一、 課程說明(Course Description) Course name: Understanding and Applying Partial Least Square-Structural Equation Modeling in Educational Studies This course is designed to provide participants with a conceptual foundation in second-generation statistical analysis, specifically Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The analytical process will follow a two-stage approach: first, evaluating the measurement model, and subsequently, assessing the structural model. In addition, the course will introduce the four types of higher-order constructs and guide participants through the analysis of higher-order measurement models. Finally, mediation and moderation analyses will be conducted within a comprehensive structural model framework. Students are able to 1. under the conceptual and methodological understanding of PLS-SEM in educational studies 2. assess the measurement model and structural model for both unidimensional and multidimensional variables. 3. analyze the mediating and moderating effects in a structural model. 二、 指定用書(Text Books) Reading materials will be assigned. Hair, J. F., Hult, G. T. M., Ringle, C. M., & Sarstedt, M. (2017). A primer on partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) (2nd ed.). SAGE Publications, Inc. 三、 參考書籍(References) Hair, J. F., Risher, J. J., Sarstedt, M., & Ringle, C. M. (2019). When to use and how to report the results of PLS- SEM. European Business Review, 31(1), 2–24. https://doi.org/10.1108/EBR-11-2018-0203 四、 教學方式(Teaching Method) - Lecture, hands-on activities 五、 教學進度(Syllabus) Day Topic Week 1 -Day 1 Part 1: Understanding the concept of multivariate analysis Part 2: understand the concept of PLS-SEM Part 3: Why use PLS-SEM instead of Covariance-based SEM? Week 1-Day 2 Two-stages approach: Part 1: The assessment of measurement model Part 2: The assessment of structural model Week 2-Day 1 Part 1: Types of Higher-order construct Part 2: The analysis of higher-order constructs in a structural model Week 2- Day 2 Part 1: Mediation analysis Part 2: Moderation analysis • Lectures will include hands-on activities to enhance practical understanding. Students need to install the SmartPLS software in their laptop. Source: https://www.smartpls.com/faq/license-and-installation/license-options/

docs.text: 表演藝術健康與跨領域科學：國際密集工作坊 Performing Arts Health and Interdisciplinary Science: International Intensive Workshop 學分 / Credits 1 授課時數（小時）/ Contact Hours (h) 16 授課教師 / Instructor Dr. Aviva L. Wolff 授課教師簡介/ Instructor Bio Aviva L. Wolff 教育博士、職能治療師與認證手部治療 師；現任紐約特種外科醫院(HSS)動作分析實驗室臨 床科學家與資深手部治療師，兼任威爾康奈爾醫學 院臨床復健醫學助理教授；亦為茱莉亞音樂學院顧 問，致力於音樂家肌骨健康(MHM)研究與推廣。 Clinician Scientist (Motion Analysis Lab) and Senior Hand Therapist at Hospital for Special Surgery; Assistant Professor of Clinical Rehabilitation Medicine, Weill Cornell Medicine; Consultant Hand Therapist, The Juilliard School. 課程目標 / Course Objectives 1. 描述與器樂演奏及日常活動相關之上肢 （肩、肘、腕與手）主要生物力學原理。 1. Describe key biomechanical principles of the upper extremity (shoulder, elbow, wrist, and hand) relevant to instrumental performance and daily activities. 2. 辨識音樂家常見的上肢動作功能障礙與過 度使用傷害型態，並納入一般性關節過度活 動度（hypermobility）與音樂家局灶性肌張 力不全（musician’s dystonia／task-specific dystonia）之臨床線索，連結其與技巧、練習 習慣及樂器特定需求之關係。 2. Identify common patterns of upper extremity movement dysfunction and overuse injuries in musicians, including considerations for generalized joint hypermobility and clinical features of musician's dystonia (task-specific dystonia), and relate these to technique, practice habits, and instrument-specific demands. 3. 將基本動作分析與穿戴式感測技術概念應 用於臨床與表演情境中的上肢動作評估。 3. Apply basic concepts of motion analysis and wearable sensor technology to the assessment of upper extremity movement in clinical and performance settings. 4. 設計以音樂家為中心、具證據基礎之介入 策略（教育、運動、支架/副木、練習調 整），包含關節穩定與本體覺訓練，以及針 對音樂家肌張力不全之感覺-動作再訓練概 念，並依個別職能與表演需求量身訂做。 4. Design musician-centered, evidence- informed intervention strategies (including education, exercise, splinting, and practice modification), incorporating joint stabilization/proprioceptive training and core concepts of sensorimotor retraining for musician's dystonia, tailored to individual occupational and performance needs. 5. 提出「音樂家肌骨健康（MHM）」計畫之 核心構成，並在自身機構或社區情境中擬定 可行的推動或研究方案。 5. Propose components of a Musculoskeletal Health for Musicians (MHM) program and outline a feasible implementation or research plan in their own institutional or community context. 課程架構與時程 / Course Structure and Schedule 課程主題 / Workshop Theme: 「表演音樂家之肌骨健康與動作分析」 / “Musculoskeletal Health and Motion Analysis for Performing Musicians” 日期 / Date 時間 / Time 主題 / Topic 內容說明 / Description 4 月 19 日（週 日） Apr 19 (Sun) 09:00-12:00 表演中的上肢生物力 學基礎 Foundations of Upper Extremity Biomechanics in Performance 上肢解剖與功能性運動學概 述；介紹關節座標系統，以及 腕與肘在功能與表演任務中的 耦合運動；以案例說明微小動 作模式改變如何影響負荷、效 率與表現品質。並導入關節穩 定性與本體覺控制概念，討論 一般性關節過度活動度 （hypermobility）在演奏中的 生物力學影響與常見代償模 式。 Overview of upper extremity anatomy and functional kinematics; introduction to joint coordinate systems and coupling motions of the wrist and elbow during functional and performance tasks; review of case examples illustrating how subtle changes in movement patterns affect load, efficiency, and performance quality in musicians. Introduces concepts of joint stability and proprioceptive control, with discussion of how generalized joint hypermobility can influence performance biomechanics and compensatory strategies. 4 月 19 日（週 日） Apr 19 (Sun) 13:20-14:10 分組討論與報告 Group Discussion & Presentations 討論主題：看見不可見：動作 分析揭示的技巧細節（含關節 穩定與過度活動度的觀察） Discussion topic: Seeing the Invisible: What Motion Analysis Reveals about Technique (including observations related to joint stability and hypermobility) 4 月 19 日（週 日） Apr 19 (Sun) 14:20-17:20 音樂家的過度使用傷 害與風險因子 Overuse Injuries and Risk Factors in Musicians 介紹器樂音樂家表演相關上肢 疾患之流行病學與臨床表現； 風險因子包含練習量、姿勢、 樂器人體工學與心理社會因 素。特別討論一般性關節過度 活動度／結締組織相關表現作 為風險因子：關節不穩定、疲 勞、肌腱負荷、本體覺下降與 疼痛敏化；並介紹臨床快速篩 檢（例如 Beighton）與轉介考 量。導入以音樂家為中心之評 估架構，以及上肢疼痛與功能 的結果量表。 Epidemiology and clinical presentation of performance- related upper extremity disorders in instrumental musicians; risk factors including practice load, posture, instrument ergonomics, and psychosocial elements. Includes focused discussion of generalized joint hypermobility/connective tissue- related presentations as risk factors (joint instability, fatigue, tendon loading, reduced proprioception, and pain sensitization), with introduction to rapid clinical screening (e.g., Beighton) and referral considerations. Introduces musician-centered assessment frameworks and outcome measures for upper extremity pain and function. 4 月 19 日（週 日） Apr 19 (Sun) 17:30-18:20 分組討論與報告 Group Discussion & Presentations 討論主題：從練習習慣到傷害 風險（含過度活動度之負荷管 理與早期肌張力不全警訊） Discussion topic: From Practice Habits to Injury Risk (including load management in hypermobility and early warning signs of dystonia) 4 月 20 日（週 一） Apr 20 (Mon) 09:00-12:00 評估與介入：從診間 到舞台 Assessment and Intervention: From Clinic to Stage 示範腕、肘與手功能之臨床評 估（實作）；介紹定量與定性 動作分析工具（影像分析、動 作擷取、穿戴式慣性感測 器）。納入鑑別診斷重點：辨 識音樂家局灶性肌張力不全 （musician’s dystonia／task- specific dystonia）與疼痛、過 度使用傷害或技巧問題之臨床 線索，並示範如何以動作分析 與感測資料支持判讀。討論具 證據之介入方式，包括運動處 方、支架/副木、分級活動、關 節穩定與本體覺訓練，以及音 樂家專屬再訓練策略（含感覺- 動作再訓練、練習結構調整、 分級暴露等）。並介紹遠距醫 療與混合式模式作為後續支持 與追蹤選項，以及何時需神經 科與跨專業合作。 Hands-on demonstration of clinical evaluation of wrist, elbow, and hand function; introduction to quantitative and qualitative motion analysis tools (video analysis, motion capture, wearable inertial sensors). Includes key differential diagnosis considerations: recognizing clinical features of musician's dystonia (task- specific dystonia) versus pain, overuse injury, or technique- related issues, and demonstrating how motion analysis and sensor data can support interpretation. Discussion of evidence-based interventions including exercise prescription, splinting, graded activity, joint stabilization/proprioceptive training, and musician-specific retraining strategies (including sensorimotor retraining, practice-structure modification, and graded exposure). Telehealth and hybrid delivery models are introduced as options for ongoing support and follow-up, including when neurology and interdisciplinary collaboration are indicated. 4 月 20 日（週 一） Apr 20 (Mon) 13:20-14:10 分組討論與報告 Group Discussion & Presentations 討論主題：設計以音樂家為中 心的治療計畫（納入過度活動 度與肌張力不全之情境化策 略） Discussion topic: Designing a Musician-Centered Treatment Plan (integrating strategies for hypermobility and dystonia when relevant) 4 月 20 日（週 一） Apr 20 (Mon) 14:20-17:20 計畫設計：音樂家肌 骨健康（MHM） Program Design: Musculoskeletal Health for Musicians (MHM) 回顧既有 MHM 計畫模式與實 施科學概念；說明音樂院校與 社區音樂學校之篩檢、衛教與 早期介入要素；並探討治療 師、醫師、生物力學研究者與 音樂教育者之跨專業合作。納 入可行的健康篩檢流程設計： 疼痛/過度使用、一般性關節過 度活動度，以及早期音樂家肌 張力不全警訊；建立分級處置 與轉介路徑。引導學員將生物 力學與臨床概念轉化為可行的 計畫構成。 Review of existing Musculoskeletal Health for Musicians program models and implementation science concepts; key elements of screening, education, and early intervention programs in conservatories, universities, and community music schools; considerations for interdisciplinary collaboration among therapists, physicians, biomechanists, and music educators. Incorporates feasible health screening workflow design addressing pain/overuse, generalized joint hypermobility, and early warning signs of musician's dystonia, with tiered management and referral pathways. Students are guided to translate biomechanical and clinical concepts into feasible program components. 4 月 20 日（週 一） Apr 20 (Mon) 17:30-18:20 分組討論與報告 Group Discussion & Presentations 討論主題：打造可永續的音樂 家健康計畫（含過度活動度與 肌張力不全之篩檢、教育與轉 介） Discussion topic: Building a Sustainable Health Program for Musicians (including screening, education, and referral for hypermobility and dystonia)

docs.text: 11420IPHD700100 iPHD Seminar Location: GEN II 205 Time: R8R9 Instructor: Shu-Fen Chen Office: GEN II A607 Office hours: Thur. & Fri. 1 - 3 p.m. or by appointment E-mail: chensf@gapp.nthu.edu.tw Course Overview This course is designed for graduate students in iPhD program of NTHU to broaden their horizons in different areas. In this course, students will be required to invite speakers from interdisciplinary areas of research to share their cutting-edge results. All students are encouraged to engage in discussions with the speakers. Please refer to the Syllabus for more information. Course Policy (Tentative) 1. Attendance: There are 12 scheduled talks in this seminar series. (Note: The Course Introduction and IPhD Orientation are excluded from this count.) 2. Punctuality: Students are required to attend the seminar on time (Thursdays at 16:30), and Teaching Assistants (TAs) will record attendance. 3. Requirements to Pass: To pass this course, students must: (1) Attend at least 10 talks in total. (2) Form a team to invite a guest speaker and host the speech for that day. (3) Ask a question to at least two different speakers during the semester. You must upload your questions and the speakers' responses to the eeclass platform by the evening of the following day (Friday at 18:00). 4. Speaker Invitation: To facilitate the invitation process, please follow the workflow shown below. The group fills out the speaker’s information in the form. Propose 2 speakers from different specializations to invite and fill out the form. No Find 3 - 4 classmates to form a group and send an email to the TA for confirmation before March 13. The instructor reviews the list and assigns priorities. We will check it nightly and provide you with the updated priorities. Schedule the talk with the speaker according to the assigned priority and confirm all talk details. Yes Send a thank-you email to the speaker (cc the instructor and TA) and host the speech on the scheduled day. Speaker Accept? Please confirm with the speaker ASAP and inform the teacher and TAs via email at least one week before the presentation day. Workflow: (1) Please find 3- 4 teammates and fill out your (1) group members, (2) reserve a date for the talk, and (3) propose 2 speakers to be reviewed by the instructor. (2) The administration will review the proposed list and prioritize the invitations so students can proceed with contacting speakers. (3) Once the speaker accepts the invitation, the group can continue to schedule and confirm the details with the speaker. (4) After the talk is confirmed, the group sends a thank-you email to the speaker to confirm the invitation (cc the instructor and TA). (5) Fill out the information of the speaker in the form.
